events.detail: I've investigated the source. The root cause is in `src/storage.js`: `readDraft()` always returns an empty draft, and `writeDraft()`/`clearDraft()` are no-ops, so nothing is persisted — drafts are lost on tab switch and refresh, and clearing after save never actually happens. `src/app.js` already wires everything correctly (writes draft on input, clears on save, prepends exactly one note with a unique ID), it just needs a real storage backend.
